About Techni Tel

نبذة عن تكنيتل

TECHNI TEL was established in 1973 in the Eastern Region, Dammam, to provide telecommunication services around the region and other areas of the Kingdom.

It started with the telephone central system concept (PABX) from global brands, backed by reliable customer care and after-installation support from a network of experienced maintenance teams.

That long experience lets us introduce ourselves as a leading telecom establishment in the Eastern Region. Keeping pace with the present era, we moved into Internet Protocol (IP) systems to implement the latest technology for global voice and video communication links.

All of this makes us a reliable organization in the Eastern Region, giving day-to-day service according to customer need and current technology.

  1. 1973

    Founded in Dammam to deliver telephone and electrical services across the Eastern Region and the Kingdom.

  2. 1985

    Introduced the Electronic Telephone Central System (EPABX), plus video and audio door entry, centralized antenna, security alarm, CCTV and sound systems.

  3. 1992

    Became agent for PROTEL (Taiwan) and NAKAYO (Japan) in PBX, ELVOX and ALCAD (Europe) in satellite TV and door intercom, and GBC (USA) in CCTV. Authorized dealer for PANASONIC and NITSUKO PBX, and ESSEX, BELDEN, SYSTIMAX cabling.

  4. IP era

    Entered Internet Protocol telephony, delivering IP voice and video links such as the Avaya and Panasonic IP-PBX projects below.

Our mission
To provide the highest level of customer satisfaction, built on vast experience in the telecommunication field.

Safety policy · سياسة السلامة

Every employee shall endeavor to prevent accidental loss of human resources and other assets employed in the business.

We prevent accidental losses by:

  • Safe workplaces. Operating at all our work places in a safe and healthy environment.
  • Training. Creating loss-prevention awareness among all employees through a comprehensive programme of training and education.
  • Leader responsibility. Each leader of an operation, at every work place, is directly responsible for the safety of all human and other resources in their charge.
  • Accountability. Line managers, supervisors and lead technicians are accountable for loss-prevention efforts that eliminate the causes of accidents.
  • Systematic review. Reviewing our operations to identify potential safety hazards and plan preventive action.
